basic_info.description: Situated in the sunny vibrant Mission, this spacious top-floor Stick Vic condo has it all! Details include; high ceilings, bay windows and softwood floors that run throughout the unit. Having a flexible floor plan the unit features; a large living room, 2 bedrooms, an office and a full bath (this is a legal 3 bed unit, the 3rd bed is currently being shown as a living room). The heart of this home is the gracious sunny eat-in country kitchen that opens to a large deeded deck, which overlooks an enchanting shared garden. There is 1-car garage parking, storage and shared laundry. All just steps from the Mission's hotspots such as; Flour & Water, Central Kitchen, Urban Putt, Local's Corner and close to public trans and all the tech buses.
